item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of reminders about perspective, and that's useful. But a reminder only works if you act on it in the moment. Notice when a thought is a guess about someone else's mind, and when an old pattern is running the show. Ask whether what you're doing right now supports the life you want. If it doesn't, adjust. Your action: at midday, pause for one minute and answer that question honestly.
